# FLX-7001: observed readout predates its registered prediction

**Family:** calibration (the 7000 band)

A PredictionRecord is sealed by its registered_at instant; an ObservedReadout naming an observed_at before that instant could only have been known before the prediction was made, which makes it evidence for the prediction rather than a test of it. Register the prediction before the outcome window opens, or read the outcome again once it has.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-7001
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
